title: dev.qory.run.step_started
description: A step of the run started. A step is one named unit of the run's host work, such as a fetch, a compose or a setup command, with a start, an end, an outcome and its log lines. Steps come after dev.qory.run.started and are numbered from 1 in the order they start. The step's log lines are dev.qory.run.log events with its number as step, between this event and the step's dev.qory.run.step_exited.

step.description: The number of the step in the run, from 1.

name.description: A readable name of the step, such as fetch github.com/example-org/app.

kind.description: What the step does. fetch: a fetch of a source, such as a repository. compose: a compose of the harness. image: a fetch or a build of an image. setup: a setup command, on the machine or inside the wall. join: the join of a session. wall: the start of a wall.
